summary: Our project focuses on creating an interactive digital map that shows the locations and stories of NASA's robotic explorers left on Mars. Using NASA data, we aim to help people discover where these machines are, why they were sent to Mars, and what scientific discoveries they made during their missions. The map will provide information about important robotic explorers and their contributions to space exploration. By combining digital mapping, scientific information, and storytelling, we want to turn complex space research into an engaging and educational experience, especially for young space enthusiasts. Our goal is to bring these forgotten explorers back into the spotlight and show how their missions helped us understand the Red Planet.
